title: parley end
description: The terminal event of a run that bootstrapped: written to stdout and to the receipt as one event. Its seq is the run's final sequence number (spec §3.3).

run.description: The execution this line belongs to (spec §2.1).

status.description: The exit status the process is about to exit with (spec §3.4); never 3, since a run that could not bootstrap has no end.

receipt.description: The receipt path, absolute, as the bootstrap line declared it.

redacted.description: True exactly when the head carries redacted or any redaction event was emitted (spec §3.3).

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (spec §4.5, §4.6).
